_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. feedhive.com's declared custom-property layer (raw/css-vars.json) is thin — the Tailwind-v4 theme defaults, FeedHive's .cta-gradient-ring properties and the themed cookie-consent vendor vars — so declared scales land under core.* as {var} leaves where they resolve, and everything the site paints through arbitrary-value utilities lands as measured literals carrying the component/state they were read from. The site is light-only: the dark set stays empty.

sans.source: computed fontFamily of promo-bar default (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face declared in the site's css bundle (raw/css-vars.json fonts list)
sans.description: Inter — every control and body on the marketing site (next/font variable wght 100-900, with the local "Inter Fallback" metrics face).
